reason: Recommended 免费室内博物馆 landmark (上海博物馆（人民广场馆）): 常设展免费、全程空调且每层都有休息座椅与电梯，旺季高温或下雨时是最好的避暑避雨去处，青铜、陶瓷、书画几小时慢慢看也不累。
Recommended 古典园林 landmark (豫园): 门票仅几十元且六十岁以上有优惠，园子小巧、路线短、假山池水集中，长辈一两小时就能逛完不留体力；旺季九曲桥一带极挤，务必开园即入，逛完到商城老字号吃碗面最省钱。
Recommended 免费城市公园 landmark (人民公园): 完全免费、地势平坦、梧桐成荫，园内茶室和长椅多，是市中心零成本歇脚点；紧邻南京路却闹中取静，长辈可在此避开步行街的人流喘口气。
Recommended 免费城市公园 landmark (静安公园): 免费开放、树荫浓密、步道短而平，园内多处石凳与凉亭，坐在荷花池边看人下棋唱戏最合七十岁以上长辈的节奏，出门就是地铁二号线，转场毫不费力。

raw_name: 武康路—衡山路历史风貌街区
surface_name: 武康路—衡山路历史风貌街区
reason: Recommended 免费梧桐街区 landmark (武康路—衡山路历史风貌街区): 不收门票，法国梧桐连成绿廊、盛夏走在下面有遮阴，路面平整无台阶，边走边看老洋房，走不动了随便进家咖啡馆或公交一站接驳，是低预算又出片的慢行选择。
Recommended 低价大型绿地 landmark (世纪公园): 门票仅十元且六十岁以上免票或半价，园内道路宽阔平坦、湖边座椅充足、视野开阔不闷热，旺季人流被大面积绿地稀释，长辈可以坐电瓶车代步也不超预算。
Recommended 千年古刹 landmark (龙华寺): 香花券十元、院内全平路无台阶，殿宇间有廊下有座，长辈可慢慢上香礼佛再吃一碗素面，清净少喧嚣，是旺季里难得的清静半日。
Recommended 室内展馆 landmark (上海城市规划展示馆): 门票三十元上下、老年票更便宜，全程空调、电梯直达、每层有沙发休息区，五层巨型城市模型一站看遍上海，雨天高温天都能安心逛，性价比极高。
Recommended 水乡古镇 landmark (朱家角古镇): 进镇免费、地铁十七号线直达无需包车，沿河石板路平坦，随处可坐河埠头喝茶看船，长辈体力再好也适合这种走走停停的节奏；旺季请选工作日上午出发，避开午后团队客高峰。

Recommended Cultural landmark (Senso-ji Temple): This iconic and free-to-enter Buddhist temple in Asakusa offers a deeply traditional Japanese atmosphere with flat, walkable grounds ideal for seniors exploring Tokyo on a low budget.

Recommended Nature landmark (Ueno Park): This expansive and free public park is especially stunning during peak cherry blossom season, offering gentle walking paths and serene scenery perfectly suited for a senior companion.

Recommended Cultural landmark (Meiji Shrine): Free to enter and set within a tranquil forested path, this revered Shinto shrine provides a peaceful and spiritually enriching experience well-suited for senior visitors.

Recommended Cultural landmark (Yanaka Ginza Shopping Street): This charming, nostalgic old-town shopping street is flat, easy to stroll, and filled with affordable local snacks and crafts that seniors tend to appreciate deeply.

Recommended Nature landmark (Hamarikyu Gardens): With a modest entrance fee, this beautifully maintained traditional garden offers serene teahouse experiences and scenic waterfront views ideal for a relaxed senior outing.

Recommended Museum landmark (Tokyo National Museum): Located in Ueno with a low admission fee and senior discounts available, this museum houses Japan's finest collection of art and antiquities, offering a culturally rich and comfortable indoor experience.

Recommended Nature landmark (Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden): With a very affordable entry fee and stunning seasonal blooms during peak travel periods, this spacious garden provides a calm and beautiful retreat perfectly suited for seniors.

Recommended Shopping landmark (Nakamise Shopping Street): This historic pedestrian arcade leading to Senso-ji offers affordable traditional souvenirs and street snacks, making it a budget-friendly and leisurely experience for senior travelers.

Recommended Scenic landmark (Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building Observatory): Completely free to visit, this observation deck offers breathtaking panoramic views of Tokyo including Mount Fuji on clear days, making it an outstanding no-cost highlight for seniors.

Recommended Museum landmark (Edo-Tokyo Museum): Offering senior discounts and fascinating large-scale exhibits on Tokyo's history from the Edo period onward, this accessible and engaging museum is an excellent low-budget cultural stop for older visitors.

Recommended Religious landmark (Sagrada Família): Book the 9 a.m. timed ticket online so your 70+ companion enters in cool morning air with lift access to the towers and can rest on the shaded benches of Plaça de Gaudí before the peak-season crowds and heat arrive.

Recommended Modernista park landmark (Park Güell): Take the first timed slot of the day to see the terrace and free outer paths in shade and quiet, then ride bus 116 back down the hill instead of walking it in the afternoon sun.

raw_name: Barcelona Cathedral and the Gothic Quarter
surface_name: Barcelona Cathedral and the Gothic Quarter
reason: Recommended Historic quarter landmark (Barcelona Cathedral and the Gothic Quarter): The narrow shaded lanes, cloister seats and cheap off-peak entry hours make a slow, sit-down-friendly morning that costs almost nothing and never requires standing in a long line.

Recommended Market landmark (Mercat de Sant Antoni): Browsing is free, the restored hall is covered and cool, and counter stools serve cheap coffee and tapas, making it an easy low-budget lunch stop with built-in seating for an older traveler.

Recommended Museum landmark (Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya): Free Saturday-afternoon entry, escalators up from Plaça d'Espanya and fully lift-served, air-conditioned halls with a terrace café give a full, comfortable half-day at almost no cost.

raw_name: El Born Centre de Cultura i Memòria
surface_name: El Born Centre de Cultura i Memòria
reason: Recommended Cultural centre landmark (El Born Centre de Cultura i Memòria): Free entry to the covered 1706 archaeological site, with air conditioning and abundant seating, makes it the ideal zero-cost refuge during the hottest, most crowded hours of peak season.

Recommended City park landmark (Parc de la Ciutadella): Flat gravel paths, dense tree shade, lakeside benches and free admission let your companion stroll and rest at will with no stairs, tickets or queues.

Recommended Architectural boulevard landmark (Passeig de Gràcia Modernisme walk): Casa Batlló and La Pedrera are fully visible from the street for free, and the wide plane-tree-shaded pavement with benches lets you enjoy them without paying for interiors or queueing in the sun.

Recommended Museum landmark (Museu Picasso): Aim for a free late-afternoon or first-Sunday slot so the collection costs nothing, arriving at the start of the session when the medieval courtyards are cool, quiet and easy to move through.

raw_name: Mirador de l'Alcalde and the Miramar gardens
surface_name: Mirador de l'Alcalde and the Miramar gardens
reason: Recommended Viewpoint landmark (Mirador de l'Alcalde and the Miramar gardens): Bus 150 from Plaça d'Espanya drops you at the top, delivering a free panoramic rest stop with benches, shade, toilets and a café instead of a long uphill climb.
Recommended imperial altar park landmark (天坛公园): 旺季门票仅15元且60岁以上凭证免票，园内步道平坦、树荫与长椅密集，清晨入园既能看本地人晨练又刚好躲开旅行团高峰。
Recommended imperial garden landmark (颐和园): 旺季30元、60岁以上免票，长廊一线平坦有遮阴，还能坐游船代步省脚力，开园即入最凉快也最清静。
Recommended imperial palace landmark (故宫博物院): 60岁以上半价（旺季30元），中轴线全程平地且殿与殿之间休息处多，赶开门第一波进场可避开正午高温与人流。
Recommended imperial lake park landmark (北海公园): 门票10元并有老人优惠，环湖步道平缓、座椅多，可租船或慢登白塔，午后在柳荫下坐着休息几乎不费体力。
Recommended museum landmark (首都博物馆): 免费预约、全馆电梯加空调、休息座椅充足，是高温午后或下雨天最舒服的零花费避暑选项。
Recommended tibetan buddhist temple landmark (雍和宫): 门票25元、老人有优惠，院落紧凑一小时内可逛完，全程平地且看点密集，很适合安排在体力有限的一天。
Recommended lake and hutong quarter landmark (什刹海・胡同区): 完全免费、沿湖路面平整，走累了随时能坐三轮车或进茶馆歇脚，傍晚凉快时看老北京日常最惬意。

raw_name: 前门大街・大栅栏 (Qianmen Street)
surface_name: 前门大街・大栅栏 (Qianmen Street)
reason: Recommended historic shopping street landmark (前门大街・大栅栏): 免费开放的平整步行街，有轨电车可代步，老字号小吃单价低，适合傍晚散步顺便解决一顿便宜饭。
Recommended zoo and garden landmark (北京动物园): 门票15元、60岁以上免票，园区步道平坦、遮阴座椅多，熊猫馆等室内展馆正好用来躲开正午暴晒。
Recommended great wall landmark (八达岭长城): 60岁以上免票，从北京北站坐市郊铁路S2直达且票价很低，可选缆车省爬升，赶清晨首班车往返即可避开旺季人潮与烈日。

Recommended Cultural/Religious landmark (Wat Phra That Doi Suthep): This iconic mountaintop temple offers a spiritually enriching experience with manageable stair climbing or a tram option, making it ideal for a senior traveler on a low budget with free or minimal entry fees.

Recommended Cultural/Religious landmark (Wat Chedi Luang): Located in the heart of the Old City, this ancient temple is easily walkable, historically fascinating, and charges only a small entrance fee perfect for a budget-conscious senior visitor.

raw_name: Chiang Mai Old City Moat and Walls
surface_name: Chiang Mai Old City Moat and Walls
reason: Recommended Historical landmark (Chiang Mai Old City Moat and Walls): A free, leisurely stroll along the historic moat and restored city walls provides gentle exercise and rich cultural scenery perfectly suited for an active senior on a tight budget.

Recommended Cultural/Market landmark (Warorot Market (Kad Luang)): This bustling, affordable local market offers authentic Thai goods, street food, and vibrant atmosphere at very low cost, giving a senior traveler an immersive cultural experience.

Recommended Cultural/Religious landmark (Wat Suan Dok): This serene temple with striking white chedis and royal ashes is free to enter and offers a calm, uncrowded environment that is comfortable and enjoyable for senior visitors.

Recommended Cultural/Market landmark (Sunday Walking Street (Wualai Road)): This popular weekly street market features affordable handicrafts, local food, and live performances on flat, walkable roads ideal for a senior exploring Chiang Mai on a low budget.

Recommended Cultural/Museum landmark (Chiang Mai National Museum): With a very low entrance fee, this air-conditioned museum offers a comfortable and educational overview of Lanna history and culture, making it a perfect low-budget outing for a senior traveler.

Recommended Nature landmark (Doi Inthanon National Park): Thailand's highest peak features cool peak-season temperatures, scenic viewpoints, and well-maintained walking paths that are accessible and refreshing for a senior traveler at a modest park entry fee.

Recommended Cultural/Religious landmark (Wat Phra Singh): One of Chiang Mai's most revered temples, it features beautiful Lanna architecture, shaded grounds, and a small entrance fee, offering a peaceful and culturally rich experience for senior visitors.

Recommended Leisure/Social landmark (Nimmanhaemin Road): This trendy yet relaxed tree-lined street offers affordable cafes, gentle walking, and people-watching opportunities that provide a comfortable and enjoyable outing for a senior traveler during the busy peak season.

Recommended free city park & teahouse landmark (人民公园 People's Park): Entry costs nothing, the paths are flat and shaded, and the Heming teahouse gives a 70-plus companion a cheap pot of tea with unlimited people-watching, benches and clean toilets — best visited before 9am in high season when the city is still cool and quiet.

Recommended Buddhist temple & tea garden landmark (文殊院 Wenshu Monastery): Admission is free, the whole compound is level and wheelchair-smooth with courtyards of old trees for shade, and the vegetarian restaurant and teahouse inside mean a senior traveller can sit, eat cheaply and rest without leaving the grounds.

Recommended free museum landmark (成都博物馆 Chengdu Museum): Free entry with ID, fully air-conditioned with lifts and seating on every floor, and a superb place to spend the hottest, most crowded hours of peak season in comfort — reserve the free timed ticket online a day ahead.

raw_name: 杜甫草堂 (Du Fu Thatched Cottage)
surface_name: 杜甫草堂 (Du Fu Thatched Cottage)
reason: Recommended historic garden museum landmark (杜甫草堂 Du Fu Thatched Cottage): Visitors aged 60 and over enter free with a passport, the grounds are a flat loop of bamboo groves and ponds with pavilions to sit in, and the many shaded resting spots make it easy to pace a half-day visit even in the summer crowds.

Recommended Three Kingdoms shrine landmark (武侯祠 Wuhou Shrine): Seniors over 60 get in free, the site is compact and level so it never becomes an endurance walk, and its red-walled bamboo corridor is the classic Chengdu photo stop right beside Jinli, letting one short outing cover two sights.

Recommended folk-culture street landmark (锦里 Ancient Street): No ticket is needed, it is a single flat lane with snack stalls at very low prices, and going at opening time or after 8pm in peak season avoids the midday crush while still delivering lanterns, teahouses and free entertainment.

Recommended historic lane quarter landmark (宽窄巷子 Kuanzhai Alley): A free, flat three-lane quarter packed with teahouses, ear-cleaning stalls and cheap street food, and its side courtyards offer benches and shade to retreat to whenever the peak-season crowds on the main lane get tiring.

Recommended Taoist temple landmark (青羊宫 Qingyang Palace): The ticket is only a token few yuan and free for seniors, the courtyards are flat, quiet and heavily shaded, and it sits a short taxi ride from the centre — an inexpensive, unhurried half-hour stop that suits a low budget and older legs alike.

Recommended bamboo riverside park landmark (望江楼公园 Wangjianglou Park): Cheap or free entry, entirely level riverside paths under a dense bamboo canopy that stays noticeably cooler than the street, plenty of benches facing the river, and far fewer tour groups than the headline sights in high season.

raw_name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地 (Chengdu Panda Base)
surface_name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地 (Chengdu Panda Base)
reason: Recommended wildlife park landmark (成都大熊猫繁育研究基地 Panda Base): Seniors get a reduced or free ticket, the internal paths are smooth with a paid shuttle for tired moments, and since mobility is unrestricted the only real adaptation is arriving at the 7:30am opening in peak season to see the pandas active and escape both the heat and the worst queues.
Recommended 历史街区 landmark (大理古城): 全城免门票，复兴路与人民路石板平整且沿途茶馆、长椅密集，70岁以上长者可以走走停停；旺季清晨出门就能避开人潮，吃住也最省钱。

raw_name: 洱海生态廊道（才村—龙龛段）
surface_name: 洱海生态廊道（才村—龙龛段）
reason: Recommended 湖滨步道 landmark (洱海生态廊道（才村—龙龛段）): 全程无台阶的平坦步道，每隔几百米就有座椅和遮阴亭，长者傍晚走一段看日落即可，免费且不必包车。
Recommended 佛教古建 landmark (崇圣寺三塔): 中轴线平缓，园区有电瓶车可代步，70岁以上凭身份证通常免票或半价，是花最少体力看大理头号地标的选择。
Recommended 白族古村 landmark (喜洲古镇): 免票进镇，四方街到大院一路平路，旺季早上九点前进村人少阴凉，几块钱一个的喜洲粑粑也合低预算。

raw_name: 大理市博物馆（杜文秀帅府旧址）
surface_name: 大理市博物馆（杜文秀帅府旧址）
reason: Recommended 博物馆 landmark (大理市博物馆（杜文秀帅府旧址）): 免费开放，院落平整且室内有座椅，正好用来躲开旺季正午的暴晒或阵雨，长者看展不费腿脚。
Recommended 园林 landmark (三塔倒影公园): 门票很便宜，园内是平坦小径与湖边平台，走十分钟就能拍到三塔全景，适合想留影又不想久走的长者，一小时即可逛完。
Recommended 手工艺村 landmark (周城村（扎染体验）): 进村免费、巷道平坦，花几十元就能坐着跟白族阿婆学扎染，全程有屋檐遮阴，旺季遇雨也能照常安排。
Recommended 城市公园 landmark (洱海公园（下关）): 免费开放、湖边步道宽阔平直且长椅成排，紧邻火车站与客运站，长者到埠当天或返程前顺路逛一小时最省交通费。
Recommended 历史古城 landmark (巍山古城): 从大理坐火车约一小时直达，拱辰楼一线主街平坦，游客量远低于大理古城，旺季也能从容慢逛，吃住物价更低。
Recommended 山泉公园 landmark (蝴蝶泉公园): 园区不大且主路无台阶、竹林遮阴，70岁以上多为免票，从喜洲顺路过来半小时逛完，不会让长者多走冤枉路。

raw_name: Ribeira District and Cais da Ribeira
surface_name: Ribeira District and Cais da Ribeira
reason: Recommended Historic waterfront landmark (Ribeira District and Cais da Ribeira): the flat, car-free riverside promenade gives a 70+ traveler hours of easy strolling with constant benches, shade and cafes, and it costs nothing, though in peak season you should walk it before 10am or after 6pm when the tour groups thin out.

Recommended Public garden landmark (Jardins do Palácio de Cristal): free entry and gently sloping shaded paths with plenty of seating and clean toilets make this the best low-cost place to rest through the midday heat, with Douro views that need no climbing.

Recommended Azulejo landmark (São Bento Railway Station): the famous blue-and-white tile hall is free, indoors, air-conditioned in summer and viewable in ten minutes with benches nearby, which suits a budget-conscious senior better than any paid queue in peak season.

Recommended Covered market landmark (Mercado do Bolhão): free to enter and fully indoors, it offers cool shade, seating, clean facilities and cheap freshly made snacks, making it an ideal low-cost lunch stop when the August sun is at its strongest.

Recommended Cathedral landmark (Sé do Porto): entry costs only a few euros, the terrace delivers the classic rooftop view without a long climb, and the cloister is cool and quiet, so visit at opening time to avoid cruise-ship crowds; ask at the desk about the 65+ reduction.

Recommended Baroque church landmark (Igreja de São Francisco): a modest ticket buys one of Europe's most spectacular gilded interiors, it is fully indoors and cool, and the visit takes under an hour, perfect for a senior traveler wanting high impact on a low budget.

raw_name: Ponte Dom Luís I (lower deck walk to Gaia)
surface_name: Ponte Dom Luís I (lower deck walk to Gaia)
reason: Recommended Iron bridge landmark (Ponte Dom Luís I (lower deck walk to Gaia)): crossing the lower deck on foot is free and level, taking you straight from Ribeira to the Gaia riverside with no stairs or fare, and going early keeps you clear of the peak-season crush.

Recommended Riverside promenade landmark (Cais de Gaia): the Gaia quay is flat, free and lined with benches facing Porto's postcard skyline, and you can enjoy the port-wine atmosphere without paying for a lodge tour by ordering a single glass at a terrace.

raw_name: Historic Tram Line 1 to Foz do Douro
surface_name: Historic Tram Line 1 to Foz do Douro
reason: Recommended Heritage tram landmark (Historic Tram Line 1 to Foz do Douro): a single low-cost ticket replaces a long hot walk with a scenic ride along the river to Foz, where the flat seaside promenade, shade and Atlantic breeze are ideal for a 70+ traveler in peak season.

Recommended Art museum landmark (Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis): one of Porto's cheapest museums with a tranquil shaded courtyard, indoor galleries and seating throughout, and it stays quiet even in August, so it makes a calm, cool afternoon for a budget-minded senior.

Recommended free-entry cathedral landmark (Notre-Dame Cathedral): entry costs nothing and the restored interior offers cool, level floors with plenty of seating, so arrive at opening time in peak season to beat the queues and let a 70-plus companion rest in the shaded parvis afterwards.

Recommended free public garden landmark (Jardin du Luxembourg): admission is free, the gravel paths are flat and the green metal chairs can be pulled into shade or sun, making it the ideal low-cost two-hour breather between paid sights in summer heat.

Recommended free fine-arts museum landmark (Petit Palais): the permanent collection costs nothing, the air-conditioned rooms are uncrowded compared with the big museums and come with armchairs throughout plus a shaded garden café for a cheap sit-down.

Recommended free history museum landmark (Musée Carnavalet): free permanent entry, lifts between floors and benches in almost every room give a 70-plus visitor an effortless, cool, crowd-free way to understand Paris without spending a cent.

raw_name: Galerie Vivienne and the covered passages
surface_name: Galerie Vivienne and the covered passages
reason: Recommended free historic arcade landmark (Galerie Vivienne and the covered passages): flat, step-free, glass-roofed and free to wander, these 19th-century arcades give shelter from midday sun or a downpour and put a mosaic-floored café within a few paces whenever your companion needs to sit.

raw_name: Arènes de Lutèce and Rue Mouffetard
surface_name: Arènes de Lutèce and Rue Mouffetard
raw_category: free Roman ruins and market street
reason: Recommended free Roman ruins and market street landmark (Arènes de Lutèce and Rue Mouffetard): the Gallo-Roman arena is free, quiet and bench-lined, and the adjoining market street supplies a cheap picnic lunch to eat in the shade before the afternoon crowds build.

Recommended free historic cemetery landmark (Père-Lachaise Cemetery): paved, gently sloping, tree-shaded avenues with frequent benches make this free open-air museum of famous graves a calm, unhurried morning outing even at the height of the season.

raw_name: Île Saint-Louis and the Seine banks
surface_name: Île Saint-Louis and the Seine banks
reason: Recommended free riverside walk landmark (Île Saint-Louis and the Seine banks): a completely flat, free circuit with stone parapets for leaning, benches facing the water and ice-cream stops along the way, best done before 10am when the quays are still cool and empty.

Recommended free-to-browse covered market landmark (Marché d'Aligre): browsing costs nothing, the covered hall gives shade and the surrounding stallholders sell the cheapest quality picnic food in central Paris, with café terraces for a long, inexpensive sit-down.

Recommended low-cost royal basilica landmark (Basilica of Saint-Denis): the nave is free to enter and the royal necropolis ticket is modest, the stone interior stays cool, there is seating throughout and it draws a fraction of the central-Paris crowds, making it a restful half-day on the métro line 13.
Recommended 历史文化 landmark (开元寺): 免费开放、地面平坦无台阶，古榕成荫处处有石凳可歇脚，旺季人多时也能随时找地方坐下休息，对七十岁以上且预算有限的老人最省力省钱。

raw_name: 泉州海外交通史博物馆
surface_name: 泉州海外交通史博物馆
reason: Recommended 博物馆 landmark (泉州海外交通史博物馆): 免费入馆且有空调和电梯，展厅有座椅，是旺季高温午后最舒适的避暑式游览点，老人不必在烈日下暴走。
Recommended 历史文化 landmark (泉州府文庙): 免门票，泮池广场平整开阔、榕树遮阴，廊下长椅多，老人可慢慢走、随时坐，停留时间完全自主，花费几乎为零。

Recommended Buddhist temple landmark (Sensō-ji): The precinct is completely flat and paved, so a 70-plus companion can stroll Nakamise-dōri and the main hall without stairs or fatigue, and an 8am arrival in peak season beats both the crowds and the heat while entry stays free and budget-friendly.

Recommended Shinto shrine landmark (Meiji Jingū): A wide gravel avenue through a cathedral of trees delivers deep shade, cool air and frequent benches, making this free 90-minute loop the most comfortable big-name sight in Tokyo for a senior traveler in the July-to-August heat.

Recommended museum landmark (Tokyo National Museum): Fully air-conditioned, lift-served and generously stocked with benches and a sit-down café, it gives your companion a cool, unhurried half-day of samurai swords and screens at a modest ticket price when peak-season humidity peaks outdoors.

Recommended garden landmark (Shinjuku Gyoen): Broad asphalt paths, abundant shaded benches and several rest houses with seating let a 70-plus visitor cover the grounds slowly and comfortably, and the ¥500 entry keeps it well inside a medium budget.

Recommended garden landmark (Hama-rikyū): The level loop path is easy underfoot and the teahouse over the pond serves matcha and a sweet while your companion sits looking at the water — the ideal seated mid-afternoon pause in peak season.

Recommended performing arts venue landmark (Kabukiza): Single-act 'makumi' seats let a senior traveler enjoy one beautifully costumed act from an air-conditioned, cushioned seat for around ¥1,000–2,000, with English earphone guides and lifts to every level — culture without a four-hour sit.

Recommended observation deck landmark (Tokyo Skytree): Elevators run straight to the 350m deck where wide windows, café seating and gentle circulation mean your 70-plus companion gets the whole city in view with almost no walking, and a timed online ticket in peak season avoids the queue.

Recommended Royal Garden landmark (Royal Park Rajapruek): A tram loops the landscaped grounds and international gardens so the visit stays largely seated and shaded between stops, and the mild peak-season weather makes the outdoor pavilions genuinely comfortable.

Recommended Hot Springs landmark (San Kamphaeng Hot Springs): Private mineral baths at the adjacent high-end resorts turn this into a restorative half-day for a 70-plus guest, and the flat surrounding gardens are easy to wander in the cool season.

Recommended Museum landmark (MAIIAM Contemporary Art Museum): Fully air-conditioned with lifts and benches throughout, it is the ideal afternoon refuge when peak-season crowds fill the old city, and a private guide can pace the Lanna art collection to a senior's rhythm.

Recommended River Cruise landmark (Ping River Sunset Dinner Cruise): A seated two-hour dinner aboard a teak riverboat requires no walking at all, and the dry peak-season evenings deliver calm water and clear sunset light.

Recommended Culinary Experience landmark (Half-Day Thai Cooking Academy): A high-end academy uses seated prep stations and a private market tour, giving a culturally rich, low-stamina day that operators routinely tailor for older guests.

Recommended Mazu temple landmark (Tianhou Temple): free to enter and sitting beside the old commercial quarter, it pairs neatly with cheap street food so a couple spends almost nothing on the whole outing.

raw_name: Quanzhou Maritime Museum (泉州海外交通史博物馆)
surface_name: Quanzhou Maritime Museum (泉州海外交通史博物馆)
reason: Recommended museum landmark (Quanzhou Maritime Museum): free entry with air conditioning, making it the ideal two-hour retreat when peak-season heat or an afternoon downpour would otherwise burn your budget in cafes.

Recommended scenic mountain landmark (Qingyuan Mountain): the one modest paid ticket on this list, but a half-day of trails, stone carvings and city views that a couple with full mobility can cover on foot — start at dawn to avoid the peak-season crush and the heat.
Recommended 免费滨水地标 landmark (外滩): 情侣傍晚沿中山东一路散步看对岸灯光不花一分钱，高峰期只要避开正午和节假日20点后的人流高峰，就依然浪漫而不拥挤。
Recommended 免费历史街区 landmark (武康路—安福路街区): 梧桐树荫遮蔽的老洋房路线适合两人慢走拍照，咖啡与面包单价低，走路即可串起武康大楼、巴金故居等打卡点，预算压力几乎为零。

raw_name: 上海博物馆（人民广场馆）
surface_name: 上海博物馆（人民广场馆）
reason: Recommended 免费博物馆 landmark (上海博物馆): 免费预约入馆又全程空调，是旺季高温或雨天最省钱的两三小时避峰方案，动线集中不用赶路，适合情侣慢慢看青铜与书画。
Recommended 收费古典园林 landmark (豫园): 门票仅四十元左右即可进园，赶在8:30开门那一刻入园能避开团队客流，逛完在周边小店分食一笼小笼包，低预算也能有仪式感。

raw_name: 西岸滨江（龙美术馆一带）
surface_name: 西岸滨江（龙美术馆一带）
reason: Recommended 免费滨水艺术区 landmark (西岸滨江): 黄浦江岸线开阔、人流比外滩稀薄得多，两人可租共享单车骑行看日落，江风和草坪都是免费的高性价比约会场景。
Recommended 免费艺术场馆 landmark (PSA): 主展常设免费、室内有空调和大屋顶露台，旺季午后把最热的两小时交给它，再走到江边看船，情侣拍照出片且几乎不花钱。

raw_name: 苏州河—外白渡桥—圆明园路步行线
surface_name: 苏州河—外白渡桥—圆明园路步行线
reason: Recommended 免费城市步道 landmark (苏州河—外白渡桥—圆明园路): 一条免费步道串起老桥、仓库建筑与河景，比外滩安静许多，适合避开旺季人潮的夜走，走走停停的成本只有体力。
Recommended 免费弄堂街区 landmark (田子坊): 石库门窄巷本身不收费，适合两人随意穿行淘小店，旺季建议选工作日傍晚前往以避开白天的人贴人。
Recommended 近郊免费古镇 landmark (七宝老街): 地铁9号线直达、无门票，汤圆、海棠糕等小吃单价低，半天来回即可满足‘出城’的氛围感，对低预算情侣非常友好。

raw_name: 复兴公园与思南公馆周边
surface_name: 复兴公园与思南公馆周边
reason: Recommended 免费城市公园 landmark (复兴公园与思南公馆周边): 免费入园、树荫长椅多，可看到本地人跳舞下棋的真实市井，走累了随时坐下休息，再顺路逛思南公馆的露天街区，全程零门票。

Recommended historic temple landmark (Senso-ji Temple, Asakusa): Admission is free and the walk from Kaminarimon through Nakamise-dori to the main hall gives a couple a classic, atmospheric Tokyo evening without spending anything beyond a few hundred yen on snacks.

Recommended shinto shrine and park landmark (Meiji Jingu and Yoyogi Park): The forested shrine approach costs nothing, is blissfully shaded on hot peak-season afternoons, and flows straight into Yoyogi Park for a cheap picnic lunch.

raw_name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building Observatory, Shinjuku
surface_name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building Observatory, Shinjuku
reason: Recommended free observation deck landmark (Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building Observatory, Shinjuku): Two observatories at 202 metres cost zero yen, making this the best budget substitute for paid skyline attractions and a reliable sunset spot for two.

Recommended landscape garden landmark (Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden): At around 500 yen per person it is the cheapest large-scale garden in central Tokyo, with lawns and ponds that suit couples and enough space to escape peak-season crowds.

Recommended city park and market landmark (Ueno Park and Ameyoko Market): The park itself is free and adjacent Ameyoko offers the cheapest street-food and market browsing in Tokyo, so a couple can eat well for well under 2,000 yen total.

Recommended food market landmark (Tsukiji Outer Market): You can build a shared breakfast from tamagoyaki skewers, grilled seafood and mochi for a few hundred yen each, making it the highest-value low-budget food experience in the city.

Recommended palace garden landmark (Imperial Palace East Gardens): Entry is free, the grounds are spacious and quiet, and an early-morning visit pairs neatly with a stroll to Tokyo Station without any transport cost.

Recommended park and pond landmark (Inokashira Park, Kichijoji): A rowboat rental costs only a few hundred yen for the two of you, and the tree-lined pond plus nearby Shimokitazawa make a relaxed, budget-friendly day out.

Recommended historic neighbourhood landmark (Yanaka and Nezu old-town walk): Wandering the lanes, cemetery cherry path and small shrines costs nothing and gives couples a slower, more intimate side of Tokyo than the peak-season headline sights.

raw_name: Odaiba Seaside Park and Rainbow Bridge promenade
surface_name: Odaiba Seaside Park and Rainbow Bridge promenade
reason: Recommended waterfront park landmark (Odaiba Seaside Park and Rainbow Bridge promenade): Free beach, free bridge views and a cheap evening picnic spot combine with the Yurikamome line ride for a romantic low-cost night out.

Recommended Landmark landmark (Sagrada Família): This iconic Gaudí basilica offers couples a breathtaking and romantic architectural experience that is the unmissable centerpiece of any Barcelona visit.

Recommended Park landmark (Park Güell): The colorful mosaic terraces and panoramic city views make this a magical and romantic outdoor escape perfect for couples exploring together during the vibrant peak season.

Recommended Cultural District landmark (Gothic Quarter (Barri Gòtic)): Wandering the narrow medieval lanes hand-in-hand offers couples an atmospheric and historically rich experience at little to no cost.
Recommended Beach landmark (La Barceloneta Beach): This lively urban beach provides couples with a classic Mediterranean seaside experience perfectly suited to the warm peak-season weather.

Recommended Food Market landmark (La Boqueria Market): Sampling fresh local produce, tapas, and regional specialties together makes this vibrant market a delightful and affordable culinary adventure for couples.
Recommended Architecture landmark (Casa Batlló): Gaudí's fantastical façade and immersive interior tour create a uniquely romantic and visually stunning experience well within a medium budget.
Recommended Scenic Viewpoint landmark (Montjuïc Castle and Hill): The sweeping harbor and city views from this hilltop fortress provide a wonderfully romantic setting for couples to enjoy together.

Recommended Concert Hall landmark (Palau de la Música Catalana): Attending an evening concert or guided tour of this stunning Modernista venue offers couples a sophisticated and memorable cultural experience at a medium price point.

Recommended Neighborhood landmark (El Born Neighborhood): This trendy district blends boutique shopping, craft cocktail bars, and excellent mid-range restaurants, making it an ideal evening destination for couples seeking local atmosphere.

Recommended Entertainment landmark (Tibidabo Amusement Park): Perched atop the city's highest hill, this charming historic park combines thrilling rides with spectacular panoramic views, offering couples a fun and memorable peak-season outing.
Recommended 历史宫殿建筑 landmark (故宫博物院): 旺季虽人多，但全网实名预约、早间入宫即可避开团队高峰，情侣半天可走完中轴线并顺路看珍宝馆，中等预算也负担得起。
Recommended 世界遗产古迹 landmark (慕田峪长城): 相比八达岭更清静、缆车直达敌楼，无行动限制的情侣可以徒步走到二十号敌楼，旺季也不至于寸步难行。
Recommended 皇家园林 landmark (颐和园): 昆明湖与长廊提供大量树荫和歇脚处，盛夏正午也能临水小坐，适合中等预算的轻松半日游。
Recommended 祭祀古建与城市公园 landmark (天坛公园): 门票低廉，清晨可见本地人晨练、合唱的生活场景，情侣能以很少的花费体会到最日常的北京。
Recommended 城市观景公园 landmark (景山公园): 几元门票登万春亭即可俯瞰整片紫禁城屋顶，是旺季黄昏性价比最高、最适合两人停留拍照的一站。
Recommended 胡同街区 landmark (什刹海与南锣鼓巷): 傍晚沿湖散步、坐进临水小馆吃饭，正好错开白天暴晒与旅行团高峰，两人消费可控。
Recommended 宗教与学府古建 landmark (雍和宫与国子监): 香火与古槐浓荫并存，室内殿宇与院落交替，旺季排队时间短，适合安静地走上一两个小时。
Recommended 当代艺术街区 landmark (798艺术区): 多数画廊有空调、展览免费或低票价，最适合盛夏午后避暑，情侣可边逛边歇。
Recommended 综合博物馆 landmark (中国国家博物馆): 免费预约、全程空调恒温，可作为正午高温时段的室内替代方案，一次看完从远古到近代的主线。

raw_name: 奥林匹克公园（鸟巢·水立方）
surface_name: 奥林匹克公园（鸟巢·水立方）
reason: Recommended 现代城市地标 landmark (奥林匹克公园（鸟巢·水立方）): 广场开阔、夜灯亮起后无需门票即可散步，适合晚饭后两人消磨一两个小时再回酒店。

Recommended sacred temple landmark (Wat Phra That Doi Suthep): The 306-step naga staircase and summit terrace make a rewarding shared climb for a mobile couple, and a medium budget easily covers the songthaew up plus the small entry fee, so go early on a cool peak-season morning before the tour buses arrive.

raw_name: Wat Chedi Luang and the Old City temple circuit
surface_name: Wat Chedi Luang and the Old City temple circuit
reason: Recommended historic temple landmark (Wat Chedi Luang and the Old City temple circuit): The ruined Lanna chedi and neighbouring Wat Phra Singh sit within an easy half-day walk or short ride, giving a couple maximum sightseeing per baht, and peak-season temperatures make strolling the moat-side lanes genuinely pleasant.

Recommended national park landmark (Doi Inthanon National Park): Thailand's highest peak delivers cloud-sea sunrises, twin royal chedis and the Wachirathan waterfall on one full-day itinerary that a couple can share cheaply by hired songthaew or joined tour, and the summit is genuinely cold in peak season, so bring a layer.

Recommended ethical wildlife sanctuary landmark (Elephant Nature Park): A no-riding, observation-only day trip suits a couple who want a responsible animal encounter, and the medium-tier day package including transport and vegetarian lunch books out weeks ahead in peak season, so reserve early.

Recommended night market landmark (Sunday Walking Street, Ratchadamnoen Road): Handicrafts, street food and temple courtyards lit after dark make this the best-value evening out for two, and the single weekly peak-season timing means you should plan your trip dates around a Sunday if possible.

Recommended neighbourhood food district landmark (Nimmanhaemin Road and One Nimman): Cafe-hopping, Northern Thai restaurants and craft cocktail bars within walking distance give a couple a relaxed medium-budget evening, and the area's density of options is a welcome refuge when peak-season crowds fill the Old City.

raw_name: Half-day Thai cooking class with market tour
surface_name: Half-day Thai cooking class with market tour
reason: Recommended culinary experience landmark (Half-day Thai cooking class with market tour): A morning market walk followed by cooking khao soi and curries together is the most couple-friendly medium-budget activity in the city, and peak-season classes fill fast, so book a slot for your first full day and enjoy the skills all trip.

raw_name: Bua Tong Sticky Waterfalls (Nam Phu Chet Si)
surface_name: Bua Tong Sticky Waterfalls (Nam Phu Chet Si)
reason: Recommended natural attraction landmark (Bua Tong Sticky Waterfalls): The porous limestone lets you walk straight up the cascades without slipping, which is ideal for a couple with no mobility limits who want a hands-on half-day out, and it is a short, cheap ride north of the city with far thinner peak-season crowds than the headline sights.

raw_name: Wat Umong forest temple and meditation tunnels
surface_name: Wat Umong forest temple and meditation tunnels
reason: Recommended forest temple landmark (Wat Umong forest temple and meditation tunnels): Mossy brick tunnels, a wooded lake and free-roaming chickens offer a quiet, low-cost counterpoint to the marquee temples, perfect for a couple wanting an unhurried morning away from peak-season tour groups.

Recommended onsen and spa landmark (San Kamphaeng Hot Springs): Private mineral baths and riverside gardens make a restorative final-day treat for two at a modest price, and the cool peak-season evenings are exactly when soaking outside feels best.

raw_name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
surface_name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
reason: Recommended 动物保育基地 landmark (成都大熊猫繁育研究基地): 情侣同游的人气首选；旺季务必提前在线购票，并在开园时入场，这样既能避开人流高峰，也能在上午看到熊猫最活跃的状态，园内步行强度适中。
Recommended 历史街区 landmark (宽窄巷子): 两人步行即可逛完的清式院落街区，茶馆、小吃、老建筑集中，预算中等就能安排一顿地道川菜或盖碗茶；旺季建议清晨或晚上前往，避开午后最拥挤的时段。
Recommended 古街与祠庙 landmark (锦里古街与武侯祠): 一次就能逛完三国文化祠庙和夜间红灯笼古街，白天参观文物、傍晚吃小吃，节奏轻松；两处相距仅几步，体力无负担，适合情侣半天行程。
Recommended 世界遗产水利工程 landmark (都江堰水利工程): 城际高铁半小时可达，步道平整、全程无需爬升，两人一天即可往返；旺季时最好提前购买景区门票和高铁票，并选早班车，避开团队集中入园。
Recommended 道教名山 landmark (青城山（前山）): 林木幽深、道观沿山而布，情侣可乘索道省力、再缓步游览；它与都江堰适合连成一日线路，中等预算即可覆盖门票、索道和山间素斋。

raw_category: 古典园林与文学纪念地
reason: Recommended 古典园林与文学纪念地 landmark (杜甫草堂): 竹林与水榭清幽，适合两人慢走拍照，门票价格适中、园区平坦无台阶压力；旺季上午人相对少，可安排半天的静谧行程。

raw_name: 成都人民公园（鹤鸣茶社）
surface_name: 成都人民公园（鹤鸣茶社）
reason: Recommended 市井茶馆公园 landmark (成都人民公园（鹤鸣茶社）): 花几十元就能一起坐下喝盖碗茶、体验采耳，感受本地人的闲适；这里适合在旺季景点人潮后用来休整，无需预约，也无行动方面的门槛。
Recommended 考古遗址博物馆 landmark (金沙遗址博物馆): 室内展厅不受旺季天气和日晒影响，两人可安静地看太阳神鸟金饰与祭祀遗迹；门票属中等价位，建议提前网上预约，以避开周末午后高峰。
Recommended 商业街区 landmark (春熙路·太古里): 川西风格建筑与现代商圈交融，适合情侣逛街、看夜景并随手拍照；消费弹性大，中等预算可控，傍晚人流虽多，但夜晚氛围最好，附近餐饮选择也密集。

raw_name: 望江楼公园（薛涛纪念地）
surface_name: 望江楼公园（薛涛纪念地）
reason: Recommended 竹林园林 landmark (望江楼公园): 锦江边的竹林与古楼清静，是旺季避开热门景点人潮的替代选择；两人可散步、喝茶或临江小坐，门票低，园区平坦，半天时间即可从容走完。
Recommended 自然 landmark（洱海）: 情侣可租电动车或双人自行车沿环海西路慢行，旺季清晨与傍晚光线最好、人也最少，中档预算足以覆盖一整天的租车与湖畔咖啡，全程平整好走。
Recommended 历史 landmark（大理古城）: 住在古城内便于两人早晚散步、随时回客栈午休，中档价位的餐馆与咖啡馆密集，旺季避开正午人流后夜晚的人民路反而最有氛围。
Recommended 文化 landmark（崇圣寺三塔）: 大理最具代表性的合影地标，景区电瓶车与步道完善、无需担心体力，旺季建议开门即入，两小时即可逛完且门票性价比在同类景区中较高。

raw_name: 苍山（感通索道/洗马潭索道）
surface_name: 苍山（感通索道/洗马潭索道）

Recommended 历史 landmark（沙溪古镇）: 茶马古道上的安静古镇，适合情侣安排一晚住宿放慢节奏，中档民宿选择多、消费低于双廊，旺季也远比大理古城清净，寺登街与玉津桥步行即可走遍。
Recommended 手工艺 landmark（周城村）: 两人可一起体验白族扎染、亲手做一块方巾当纪念品，体验费用低、耗时约一两小时，是不受旺季人流影响的室内备选项目。
Recommended 历史 landmark（巍山古城）: 南诏发源地、游客稀少，适合把行程延长一天的情侣吃一根面、逛拱辰楼，物价与餐饮明显便宜，中档预算下性价比最高的一日往返目的地。

Recommended Architectural landmark (Dom Luís I Bridge): walking the upper deck at sunset is a free, genuinely romantic set piece, and the short metro ride or uphill walk to reach it suits a couple with no mobility limits and a medium budget.

Recommended Cultural landmark (Livraria Lello): buy the timed ticket online and go at opening, since this neo-Gothic bookshop is one of the city's most photographed interiors and queues balloon through July and August.

Recommended Architectural landmark (São Bento Railway Station): the azulejo-tiled hall costs nothing and takes twenty minutes, making it the perfect quick stop between Ribeira and the cathedral on a hot peak-season afternoon.

Recommended Religious landmark (Porto Cathedral (Sé)): the cloister's tiled terrace gives couples quiet shade and river views for a modest entrance fee, and the walk down through the old streets flows straight into Ribeira.

Recommended Scenic landmark (Clérigos Tower): climbing the 225 steps rewards you with the best 360-degree rooftop view in the city, best done right at opening before the midday heat and tour groups arrive.

Recommended Historic landmark (Palácio da Bolsa): the guided tour of the Arab Room is a short, air-conditioned indoor break with real wow-factor, well worth the ticket for a couple wanting one polished cultural stop.

raw_name: Port wine cellars, Vila Nova de Gaia
surface_name: Port wine cellars, Vila Nova de Gaia
reason: Recommended Gastronomic landmark (Port wine cellars, Vila Nova de Gaia): a mid-priced tasting at one of the lodges across the river is the classic couple's afternoon, but book a late slot online as peak-season tours sell out days ahead.
Recommended Coastal landmark (Foz do Douro): the tram ride out and the Atlantic boardwalk give you a breezy, uncrowded escape from the summer centre, ending at beach bars that stay affordable.

Recommended Modern landmark (Serralves Museum): the Art Deco villa, contemporary galleries and sculpture park make a relaxed half-day for two, and the shaded gardens are a smart refuge when peak-season temperatures peak.

Recommended iconic landmark (Eiffel Tower): The essential couple's photo stop, and booking a timed summit lift ticket online weeks ahead is what keeps peak-season queues manageable on a medium budget, with the free evening sparkle best watched from the Trocadéro gardens.

Recommended art museum landmark (Musée du Louvre): Two adults can split up and reconvene over the Denon wing highlights, and a pre-booked first-slot or Wednesday/Friday late opening turns the world's most crowded museum into a calm couple of hours.

Recommended impressionist museum landmark (Musée d'Orsay): Its converted Beaux-Arts railway hall and riverside clock window suit a romantic half-day far better than the Louvre's scale, at a lower ticket price and with noticeably shorter lines in July and August.

Recommended medieval chapel landmark (Sainte-Chapelle): A single modest ticket buys the most breathtaking interior in Paris, and going at opening time on a sunny morning puts the whole 1,113 stained-glass panels in full light for the two of you.

Recommended hilltop neighborhood landmark (Montmartre and Sacré-Cœur): A free, self-paced wander through vineyard lanes and café terraces ending at the basilica steps for sunset hits the couple-and-medium-budget brief without any ticket at all.

Recommended river landmark (Seine evening cruise): An hour-long Vedettes or Bateaux Parisiens boat at dusk delivers every floodlit monument in one sitting for around €15-20 each, the best value romantic experience in the city during peak season.
